cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept a place for you beside me in the family photograph. Don't mistake that for forgiveness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we smile now? The photographer's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for a smile is under consideration. I haven't accepted the text as an apology.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says "I'm sorry." What more do you want?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Permission to deliver it in person is granted. Begin, and I'll tell the photographer when we're ready.
